3. Challenging the ex-parte decree, the defendant no.1 of the suit filed Miscellaneous Case No.75 of 2004 for set-ting aside the ex-parte decree under Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure on the ground that no summons has been served upon him. The Trial Court rejected the miscellaneous case vide judgment and order dated 28.10.2013. 

 4. Having aggrieved, defendant-respondent no.1 filed Miscellaneous Appeal No.70 of 2013 in the Court of learned District Judge, Barishal, which on transfer was heard by the learned Joint District Judge, Additional Court, Barishal, who after hearing the parties disallowed the appeal by judgment and order dated 23.07.2017.
